paragraphs.text: Cross-country families in Pontotoc County will have three different destinations Thursday, Oct. 22. Pontotoc, North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc are listed for division meets at separate venues, according to a schedule graphic shared Tuesday by Pontotoc Athletics.
Pontotoc’s Warriors will run at Cherry Creek Orchards, 4660 Highway 345 in Pontotoc. The girls’ race is scheduled for 3 p.m., followed by the boys at 3:30 p.m.
North Pontotoc has the morning starts. The Vikings’ girls are scheduled for 10 a.m. and the boys for 10:30 a.m. at the BNA Park Soccer/Tennis Complex and Tallahatchie Trails in New Albany.

South Pontotoc’s Cougars will compete at Tomahawk Trail, 455 Stage Road in Senatobia. Their girls’ start is 3:45 p.m., with the boys scheduled for 4:30 p.m. The full athletics notice is linked below for families checking their team’s location and race time.
